prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 0114045b980d8dd4
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback with divider 64 sent 0xa5 but recv returned 0xe0 (TRAP uart data mismatch, tohost FAIL 0xdead). Start state 1 waits half-bit with 2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider but states 10/default advance on recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4), 16x too short. This early sampling shifts ser_rx into recv_pattern before full bit periods elapse, corrupting recv_buf_data to 0xe0.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 0114045b980d8dd4 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
